description: 黑方中间将军，换子后赢后
explanation_en: A sequence of intermediate captures and checks lets Black win White's queen.

intro.popup: 💡 中间招：白兵g2无根是挂子。黑方吃g2后，白方Qxf6中间吃马——黑方Rg1+中间将军！再连续换子，净赢一后！
intro.popup_en: 💡 Intermediate move: White's pawn on g2 is undefended. After Black captures it, White inserts Qxf6 to take a knight; Black replies with the intermediate check Rg1+, then forces exchanges to win White's queen.

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Rxg2吃挂兵，白Qxf6中间捉马，黑Rg1+中间将军——Rxe1+，Nxf6吃回后，黑方净赚！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: ...Rxg2 takes the loose pawn; Qxf6 is White's intermediate capture, answered by ...Rg1+! After ...Rxe1+ and ...Nxf6, Black wins the queen.

moves.popup: 黑车Rxg2！吃掉无根的挂兵——g2是挂子，黑方先发制人！
moves.popup_en: Rxg2! Black captures the undefended pawn on g2 and seizes the initiative.

moves.popup: 白后Qxf6！中间吃马——不吃回g2车，先吃f6马赚子！
moves.popup_en: Qxf6! White inserts a capture of the knight instead of recapturing the rook on g2.

moves.popup: 黑车Rg1+！中间将军——不让白后逍遥，先将军强迫白王应对！
moves.popup_en: Rg1+! Black inserts a check, forcing the white king to respond before the queen can escape.
The white king moves to e2 to answer the check.

moves.popup: 黑车Rxe1+！再次将军，吃掉白车——白方必须应对！
moves.popup_en: Rxe1+! Black captures the white rook with another check, forcing White to respond.
The white rook recaptures on e1 and ends the check.

moves.popup: 黑马Nxf6！吃回白后——连续中间招完成，黑方净赚一后！
moves.popup_en: Nxf6! The knight captures White's queen. The sequence of intermediate moves is complete, and Black has won a queen.
